title: CodeQL artifact fallback
summary: Adds CodeQL SARIF artifact and job-summary output while making Code Scanning upload opt-in.
reason: CodeQL analysis was generating SARIF but failing when uploading because Code Scanning is disabled for the private repository without GitHub Code Security/GHAS.
behavior_before: CodeQL always attempted Code Scanning upload, so private-repo runs failed after analysis even when SARIF was produced.
behavior_after: CodeQL writes SARIF under codeql-results, uploads it as an Actions artifact, summarizes finding counts, and only uploads to Code Scanning when CODEQL_UPLOAD_MODE is set.
rollback_plan: Remove the CodeQL artifact and summary steps, remove the CODEQL_UPLOAD_MODE upload override, remove the guard tokens, and delete this change packet.
notes: Preserve CodeQL SARIF as artifacts and make Code Scanning upload opt-in via CODEQL_UPLOAD_MODE.
